about.title: Turning data into solutions that create value.
about.paragraph1: I work across Data Analytics, Business Intelligence and Data Engineering, transforming data into strategic insight through SQL, Python, ETL and Power BI. My focus is on building solutions that support decision-making, automate processes and create measurable business value. I also use automation, APIs, n8n and AI agents to streamline workflows, accelerate delivery and improve operational efficiency.
about.paragraph2: What sets me apart is my experience in Software Development, using technologies such as React, Next.js, TypeScript, Python and FastAPI. This integrated perspective allows me to understand the full lifecycle of a solution, from data architecture and engineering to the delivery of modern, scalable applications.
about.paragraph3: I also have advanced English skills, which allows me to work with technical documentation, follow specialized content and collaborate with teams and professionals from different countries.
